$comment: Tokeness-owned i18n delta. `translation` holds keys upstream does not ship; `overrides` re-words keys upstream ships. The upstream bundles under src/i18n/locales are upstream-owned: never edit them, put changes here instead. See FORK-CHANGES.md §7 and scripts/fork-invariants/main.mjs (i18n checks).
